mechanism_narrative: Rising quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth rate is positive in the prior quarter but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC between GDPC1 growth and SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 9.0% signals a tightening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Unemployment rate falls below 9.0% but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC between UNRATE < 9.0% and SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in labor market strength (PAYEMS) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a virtuous cycle of rising employment and consumption, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Both PAYEMS and RSAFS are rising but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC between the interaction (PAYEMS growth and RSAFS growth) and SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary easing cycles (FEDFUNDS below 0.5%), the Federal Reserve's accommodative policy lowers discount rates and stimulates economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing and supply chain activity, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth rate is positive in the prior month but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC between INDPRO growth and SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in CPIAUCSL below -0.1% signals deflationary pressures, which reduce corporate pricing power and consumer spending, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL monthly change is below -0.1% but S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC between CPIAUCSL monthly change < -0.1% and SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand for housing and associated economic activity, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST growth rate is positive in the prior month but S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC between HOUST growth and SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising above 0.5% in the last 3 months), the Federal Reserve's policy shift increases borrowing costs and dampens economic growth, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 0.5% in 3 months but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS rising > 0.5% in 3 months and SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
